name: agent-conductor
description: Give your main agent a standing prompt your subagents never see. An AGENTS.md or an always-on rule reaches every subagent too, so a rule telling the orchestrator to delegate also tells each worker to delegate. This addresses one instruction file per agent role, re-read before every prompt and never left behind in the thread. Works in the Cursor IDE and on Cloud Agents. Also ships a gated advisor subagent, orchestrator memory, and scrubbed transcripts with a browse CLI.
